@spawn_odds = 10

# Plain generated system; mod one redefines it in a differently-named file.
basic_init_01 = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = misc_system_init
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
	}
}

home_init = {
	name = "NAME_Fixture"
	class = sc_ember
	usage = empire_init
	flags = { empire_home_system }
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
		orbit_distance = 0
	}
}

lair_init = { # trailing comment on the key line
	class = sc_pit
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
		base = @spawn_odds
		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			num_systems >= 200
		}
	}
	max_instances = 1
	flags = { guardian hostile_system }
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
		init_effect = {
			set_name = "NAME_Lair"
			create_country = {
				name = "NAME_Beast"
				type = lurker_beast
				flag = {
					icon = {
						category = "synthetic"
						file = "flag_synthetic_1.dds"
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Bodies, deposits, a dig site, a megastructure and a starbase, for the details tests.
details_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = misc_system_init
	planet = {
		name = "NAME_Fixture_Star"
		class = pc_fixture_star
		size = { min = 20 max = 30 }
		init_effect = {
			add_deposit = d_glow_2
		}
	}
	planet = {
		count = 2
		class = pc_meadow
		size = 16
		starting_planet = yes
		init_effect = {
			add_deposit = d_fixture_blocker
			random_list = {
				50 = { add_deposit = d_glow_2 }
			}
			create_archaeological_site = fixture_digsite
		}
		moon = {
			class = pc_meadow
			init_effect = { add_deposit = d_glow_2 }
		}
	}
	init_effect = {
		spawn_megastructure = { type = "fixture_gateway" }
		create_starbase = {
			size = "starbase_fixture"
			module = "shipyard"
			building = "fixture_building"
		}
	}
}

# Every orbit statement the system view lays out, for the layout test.
layout_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	asteroid_belt = { type = rocky_asteroid_belt radius = 50 }
	asteroid_belt = { type = icy_asteroid_belt radius = 90 }
	planet = {
		class = star
		orbit_distance = 0
	}
	change_orbit = 20
	planet = {
		class = pc_meadow
		size = 16
		orbit_distance = { min = 10 max = 15 }
		orbit_angle = 90
		change_orbit = 3
		moon = { class = pc_meadow orbit_distance = 5 orbit_angle = 30 }
		moon = { class = pc_meadow orbit_distance = 2 orbit_angle = { min = 10 max = 50 } }
	}
	change_orbit = 10
	planet = {
		count = { min = 1 max = 3 }
		class = pc_meadow
		orbit_distance = 20
		orbit_angle = { min = -30 max = 30 }
	}
	planet = {
		class = pc_meadow
		orbit_distance = @no_such_distance
		orbit_angle = 45
	}
	planet = {
		class = pc_meadow
		orbit_distance = 25
	}
}

# A system with a star class and nothing placed in it, for the empty details test.
empty_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = misc_system_init
}

# Every way a spawn_megastructure says where it stands, and a starbase with an owner.
structures_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = misc_system_init
	planet = {
		class = star
		size = 20
		orbit_distance = 0
		orbit_angle = 0
	}
	planet = {
		class = pc_meadow
		orbit_distance = 40
		orbit_angle = { min = 80 max = 100 }
		init_effect = {
			save_event_target_as = fixture_ring_planet
		}
	}
	planet = {
		count = 2
		class = pc_meadow
		orbit_distance = 20
		orbit_angle = 180
		init_effect = {
			solar_system = {
				spawn_megastructure = {
					type = "fixture_tank"
					planet = prev
				}
			}
		}
	}
	planet = {
		class = pc_meadow
		orbit_distance = 20
		orbit_angle = 0
		init_effect = {
			solar_system = {
				spawn_megastructure = {
					type = "fixture_system_itself"
					planet = this
				}
			}
		}
	}
	planet = {
		count = { min = 0 max = 1 }
		class = pc_meadow
		orbit_distance = 20
		orbit_angle = 0
		init_effect = {
			save_event_target_as = fixture_maybe_planet
		}
	}
	init_effect = {
		spawn_megastructure = { type = "fixture_core" }
		spawn_megastructure = {
			type = "fixture_arc"
			orbit_distance = { min = 40 max = 50 }
			orbit_angle = 225
			owner = event_target:fixture_fallen
			graphical_culture = "fixture_culture"
		}
		spawn_megastructure = {
			type = "fixture_ring"
			planet = event_target:fixture_ring_planet
			owner = root
		}
		spawn_megastructure = {
			type = "fixture_shipyard"
			planet = star
		}
		spawn_megastructure = {
			type = "fixture_near"
			coords_from = event_target:fixture_ring_planet
		}
		spawn_megastructure = {
			type = "fixture_gateway"
			random_pos = yes
			orbit_angle = 360
		}
		spawn_megastructure = {
			type = "fixture_relay_ruined"
			random_pos = yes
			orbit_angle = 360
		}
		spawn_megastructure = {
			type = "fixture_lost"
			planet = event_target:fixture_saved_by_an_event
		}
		if = {
			limit = { always = yes }
			spawn_megastructure = {
				type = "fixture_maybe"
				orbit_distance = 30
			}
		}
		spawn_megastructure = {
			type = "fixture_on_a_maybe_planet"
			planet = event_target:fixture_maybe_planet
		}
		spawn_megastructure = {
			type = "fixture_any_angle"
			orbit_distance = 35
			orbit_angle = random
		}
		spawn_megastructure = {
			type = "fixture_unread"
			orbit_distance = @fixture_no_such_distance
			orbit_angle = 90
		}
		random_neighbor_system = {
			spawn_megastructure = { type = "fixture_elsewhere" }
		}
		every_system_planet = {
			solar_system = {
				spawn_megastructure = { type = "fixture_per_planet" }
			}
		}
		random_system_planet = {
			solar_system = {
				spawn_megastructure = {
					type = "fixture_named_from_a_planet"
					planet = event_target:fixture_ring_planet
				}
			}
		}
		every_system = {
			spawn_megastructure = { type = "fixture_galaxy_wide" }
		}
		last_created_country = {
			spawn_megastructure = { type = "fixture_country_scope" }
		}
		create_starbase = {
			size = "starbase_fixture"
			owner = event_target:fixture_fallen
		}
	}
}

# A starbase made through a scripted effect that takes no parameters, and one that takes some.
citadel_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = misc_system_init
	planet = {
		class = star
		size = 30
		orbit_distance = 0
	}
	init_effect = {
		create_fixture_platform = yes
		create_fixture_citadel = yes
	}
}

# The same citadel under a condition.
citadel_if_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = misc_system_init
	planet = {
		class = star
		size = 30
		orbit_distance = 0
	}
	init_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { always = yes }
			create_fixture_citadel = yes
		}
	}
}
